Results.ReviewText: I bought my e310 natural gas grill (all ready assembled) in 2016. Replaced a couple parts, before the warranty ended! I have piped-in gas; I never needed to fill a tank and have been enjoying the grill ever since. Oh, my temperature gage hasn't worked for the past couple weeks, but I use my digital meat thermometer until I can get a replacement.  Great grill, heats up quickly, awesome product.

I’m sorry to say that I posted a negative review of my new grill a couple of weeks ago. A representative of Weber immediately reached out to me and told me how to fix my problem. 
Although I am still learning how to use this grill correctly, I can honestly say that I am thrilled to have it. I have waited years to buy this really good, high quality grill and I expect that it will last for years. 
Thank you Giovanna for straightening me out. 
Love my Weber grill!

Results.ReviewText: Was told by 2 retailers to check with Weber Grills about the parts I needed and I was warned that it could be weeks or months before I got the parts. We’re they ever wrong!!! The Webber rep I spoke with was very helpful, some parts were still covered, some were not. The total was about half what I was told to expect. And best news is everything was delivered 2 days later. 5 stars is not enough to rate this company’s commitment to customer service.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill Replacement Parts

Results.ReviewText: The stove heats up quite fast.  I also appreciate the grill utensil hooks on the table edges.
Results.Title: Very good BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Got over 10 years out of the first Weber grill.  Had some burner parts replaced under a really good warranty.  Upgraded to a 3 burner model and really like it.  Warranty on new grills even better.  Customer service outstanding.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: I had no problem with the assembly. The instructions were very clear and easy to navigate. It took about an hour and fifteen  minutes. This barbeque grills better than any of the 3 I have previously owned,very even and holds temp very well.
Results.Title: Very good product

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill to replace a Weber genesis grill that was 27 years old and was still working! This grill is about the same size and works great. This one has the black porcelain top which doesn't show smoke stains like the stainless steel top. Hope I get the same trouble free usage as my last grill. Can't beat a Weber!
Results.Title: Spirit 310 propane gas grill

Results.ReviewText: I am very pleased with my new Spirit E-310 grill. It took a while to assemble, but the instructions were good and the design made it easy to see what part went where. It performs great, heat is even and controls are convenient and work well.  I like the controls in the front panel, allowing the two side panels to be fully available to set serving items. My previous Weber lasted over 20 years with only a few part replacements, which were easily obtained from Weber. I wouldn't consider any other make than Weber for a grill purchase.
Results.Title: Good Product

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Spirit E-310 Gas Grill, which was the first Weber product I have owned. This came on the recommendation from a friend who said he has owned Weber grills for the past 25 years, and during that time has owned two. I have owned other popular brand products but needed to replace parts every two years. The assembly instructions were the clearest and easiest to follow. I like the gauge that lets you know when the tank will soon need refilling. The porcelain coated steel flavorizer bars create an even distribution of heat that gives back great taste to meat. Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: Easy to use and great taste!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, easy to use . Easy to store when not in use. Purchased from Lowes, registering was a little difficult but everything worked out.
Results.Title: Weber grill.

Results.ReviewText: I like everything about the grill except that it is very difficult to lift up a full LP gas tank to hook it on the gauge for status of fuel. Using another gauge does not appear to be an option as the hole in the base is to large to support  the tank. It ends up sitting on the ground.
Results.Title: Fuel status gauge

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber and I couldn’t be more pleased with it so far. I grill 2-4 times a week year round. This grill cooks very evenly (no hot or cool spots) and so far I haven’t had any issues with flare ups from fat or grease. It is well designed and seems to be great quality all around. I had always questioned the price of Weber grills compared to other products, but I can tell you now there is definitely a difference that is well worth the price difference. If this holds up like they say they will, I won’t ever purchase anything other than Weber grills in the future. Highly impressed. Fantastic grill.
Results.Title: Best grill I’ve ever had

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great...sorry I waited so long to buy a Weber. That being said, it is customer service that is lacking, at least in my experience. I contacted customer service about an annoying popping, gurgling sound I get when the burner(s) are on low. A representative, Kajal, contacted me twice and asked for more info. I supplied the requested info, April 9th was the last time, and no response to date. I want to know if this Spirit E-310 is safe to use
Results.Title: Safe or not!

I like the grill but the design of putting the propane canister inside the door is terrible

I have the old model in my other home which is outside the door a lot east to install

Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Love my new Spirit E-310 Gas Grill. This is our second or third Weber Grill and we wouldn't buy anything else. Strong customer service and great warranty.
Results.Title: YOU GOTTA LOVE THE GRILL

Results.ReviewText: I waited a very long time to get me a Weber grill because of the cost and finally got it!! It is the best investment if you love grilling and keep that consistent heat you need
Results.Title: Finally

Results.ReviewText: It's perfect!  The size is just right for our needs and the features are also just right. We finally moved up to a Weber gas grille after our second less expense gas grill started to seriously get old and tired. I expect a much longer, happier ownership from the Weber.
Results.Title: The Perfect Size!

Results.ReviewText: I upgraded to this Weber from a old no brand name grill we had for 6 years…not sure why we waited so long. The propane tank tells you how much gas is left by a weight scale! It rolls and locks very smoothly. The side preps areas are very durable and stable. The sales rep at big box store told me it’s all stainless steel which most grills are not so it won’t tarnish. The grates are wonderful! Durable and clean easily. The inside of the grill is all one piece so is wonderful for cleaning as grease won’t get into nooks and crannies. The flame goes from edge to edge of the grill so cooking is even. The metals plates covering the flame are very durable compared to other grills. Overall best purchase ever….don’t wait its worth it! Weber for life!
Results.Title: Weber grills for life!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
